function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment arm has a lower response rate (63.6%) than the control arm (72.3%). However, the assignment to arm is not randomised — clinicians preferentially assigned treatment to sicker patients. After deduplication, the treatment group has a higher proportion of severe cases (116/253 ≈ 45.8%) compared to the control group (116/459 ≈ 25.3%), which explains the lower response rate.", "implication": "The raw difference in response rates (treatment minus control) is confounded by baseline severity. function.name: note_finding
